subject: reasoning
concept: Coding and Decoding in Fictitious Language
question: In a certain code language, 'ORACLE' is written as 'HSVUXG' and 'DAVID' is written as 'BVJFB'. How will 'VIDEO' be written in that language?
solution:
Table of alphabets place values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The pattern follows here,

'ORACLE' is written as 'HSVUXG'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eca6a2a9cece04be7954981fb8d978f8f76b550be95a87f2e54cf4874f7669c.png] 

And,

'DAVID' is written as 'BVJFB'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1aff2875f9e0c82ce2389be051b5963054ea335b3deb9b5c3ce86630b3f0561.png] 

Similarly,

'VIDEO' be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/608482991af96a31a836a0a8b53aba12c07c48fd2d4f1bd0e229cb2e3a4497ee.png] 

Hence, 'VIDEO' is coded as '**JFBGH**'
